headline_findings: [llama.cpp changes since b10751] EAGLE-3, DFlash/DFlash-2 and DSpark speculative decoding all merged upstream in the window (2-4x datacenter speedups, greedy-lossless; MoE and long-context gains are smaller).
[llama.cpp changes since b10751] Hybrid/recurrent models (Qwen3.5/Gemma4) gained speculative checkpointing and prompt-cache fixes, but carry crash and VRAM traps on 8 GB GPUs.

[llama.cpp changes since b10751] Router multi-model mode, built-in tools + MCP stdio servers, mtmd audio/video, and a critical RPC RCE fix (b11000) are the other harness-relevant changes; Windows CUDA 13.4 zips are the baseline asset.
[Newest open models worth offering] Qwen3.8-27B (2026-08-14, Apache-2.0) is the default local quality pick with mature GGUFs; 2-bit fits 8GB VRAM + 32GB RAM via offload.
[Newest open models worth offering] Gemma 4 E2B/E4B/12B/26B-A4B/31B (Apache-2.0) are the only frontier VL family fully or partly runnable on the reference laptop.
[Newest open models worth offering] gpt-oss-20b MXFP4 remains the only frontier reasoning model fully usable on 8GB VRAM; 120b needs 64GB+.
[Newest open models worth offering] DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3/Flash, Hy4, Qwen-Max 2.4T and Mistral Medium 3.5 are API-only on this hardware (300GB-1.5TB weights).
[Newest open models worth offering] Laguna XS 2.1 (33B-A3B, OpenMDW-1.1) with DFlash drafter is the most promising fast local coding MoE; needs recent llama.cpp.
[Local image generation backends] stable-diffusion.cpp (MIT, CUDA/Vulkan, GGUF) is the embeddable local image core: sd-server speaks OpenAI, WebUI and native async APIs plus an embedded web UI

[Local image generation backends] On discrete GPUs sd.cpp runs ~1.5-3.7x slower per 1024px image than ComfyUI but needs far less VRAM and no Python stack; FLUX.1-schnell Q4 and SDXL-Turbo fit the 8 GB Ampere card
[Local image generation backends] Licences split the model menu: schnell/Qwen-Image-v1/SD3.5 are commercial-friendly while FLUX-dev and Qwen-Image-2.1 are non-commercial-only and must be gated
[Local image generation backends] LM Studio and Jan ship no local diffusion (cloud plugins/proxies and image-input only), so bundled offline image gen is a real Cerebro differentiator

[Local speech-to-text and text-to-speech] whisper.cpp v1.9.4 + whisper-server file-POST and whisper-stream mic mode is the safest offline STT default; large-v3-turbo (809M, 4 decoder layers) is ~2.7-5x faster than large-v3 at +0.4pp WER.

[Local speech-to-text and text-to-speech] Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (CC-BY-4.0, 25 langs) with NeMo-Speech.cpp q8 GGUF is the fastest accurate alternative to Whisper; batch-128 RTFx 3380 does not transfer to batch-1 laptop.

[Local speech-to-text and text-to-speech] Kokoro-82M int8 ONNX (~92MB, Apache-2.0) is the default local TTS; Piper covers ultra-cheap CPU prompts; Qwen3-TTS-0.6B reports 97ms first packet; Chatterbox Turbo/Nano give MIT-licensed cloning with watermark.

[Local speech-to-text and text-to-speech] Voice mode: ship push-to-talk first, then Silero+WebRTC dual-pass VAD auto-turn, barge-in behind a flag with AEC and <20ms TTS flush; no RTX 3070 Ti batch-1 voice latencies are published, soak-test locally.
[Hugging Face one-click downloads] Resolve-then-Range-GET with ETag pinning is the stable plain-HTTP path; HEAD gives LFS-sha256 etag, size and commit hash.
[Hugging Face one-click downloads] Multi-GB weights now live on the Xet CAS backend: plain resolve-URL follows can stall at 0 bytes; real Xet needs reconstruction-API + signed xorb fetches.
[Hugging Face one-click downloads] hf-hub Rust crate 1.0.0 (Jul 2026) gives Cerebro async/blocking search, listing, resume and Xet transfers with a Python-compatible cache.
[Hugging Face one-click downloads] Gated repos need user token + browser Agree flow; app must show licence/gated state before download and store tokens in OS keychain.
[Hugging Face one-click downloads] Rate limits are per-bucket over 5-min windows with 429 + RateLimit headers; always send HF_TOKEN and back off; hf cache verify fills the no-on-download-hash gap.
[MCP and plugin ecosystems] MCP 2026-07-28 (2026-07-28) is the stable spec: stateless core, MRTR, header routing, cacheable lists, CIMD-first auth, Tasks/Apps as extensions.
[MCP and plugin ecosystems] TypeScript SDK v2 and Rust rmcp 3.x (3.4.0 on 2026-09-15) implement 2026-07-28; rmcp is the natural dependency for a Rust harness.
[MCP and plugin ecosystems] One-click distribution is MCPB .mcpb zips + official Registry (server.json/mcp-publisher) + host galleries/deeplinks.
[MCP and plugin ecosystems] No protocol fix for tool poisoning/rug pulls: pin hashes, allowlist, sandbox, human-in-loop confirmations, gateway scanning.
[MCP and plugin ecosystems] Image-gen MCP servers are all networked/API-keyed and conflict with Cerebro offline default; gate behind explicit opt-in.

[Tool permission systems] Deny-first fixed precedence (Claude, Codex profiles) vs last-match-wins (opencode) vs model-graded safety (Cline, Cursor classifier) are the three permission design poles in 2026.
[Tool permission systems] Native Windows command sandboxing is the industry-wide hole: only experimental AppContainer/Integrity-Level approaches exist; Claude and Cursor defer to WSL2.
[Tool permission systems] Approval UX converges on once/session/always/deny plus diff or command preview; Cline's shadow-git checkpoints are the most forgiving undo model.
[Tool permission systems] Classifier auto-review modes (Claude auto, Codex auto-review, Cursor Auto-review) cut prompt fatigue but vendors state they are non-boundaries.
[Tool permission systems] Auditability is hook/transcript JSONL based; hash-chained logs, rotation, redaction and fail-closed policy are cheap patterns Cerebro can copy.
[Tauri v2 and WebView2 state] Tauri 2.11.5 + wry 0.56 is current (Sept 2026); use >=2.11.1 to avoid CVE-2026-42184 origin confusion on Windows.
[Tauri v2 and WebView2 state] Sidecar + shell-plugin arg allowlist is the sanctioned llama-server pattern: spawn from Rust, stream tokens over Channel.
[Tauri v2 and WebView2 state] Token deltas are tiny so plain Channel (fast eval path under 8 KB JSON) beats exotic binary IPC; images go via custom protocol, never invoke.
[Tauri v2 and WebView2 state] WebView2 Evergreen is preinstalled on Win11; downloadBootstrapper default keeps installer lean, offlineInstaller adds ~127 MB.
[Tauri v2 and WebView2 state] Updater minisign signing is mandatory and fits Cerebro's single opt-in network touch; MSI=WiX Windows-only, NSIS is cross-compilable.
[What rivals shipped recently] LM Studio 0.4.22-0.4.24 (Aug-Sep 2026) productized DFlash/DSpark/MTP drafters + llama.cpp argv overrides.
[What rivals shipped recently] Ollama v0.34.x adds ChatGPT Desktop reuse, cached-token reporting, deprecates typical_p; GGUF create now needs llama.cpp tooling.
[What rivals shipped recently] KoboldCpp 1.119-1.121 adds Minimax H3 video, DSpark/DFlash, --ffncpu and --usedirectio offload/IO flags.
[What rivals shipped recently] Open WebUI v0.11.1-v0.11.4 adds approval-gated tools, ask_user, delta streaming (787x saving claimed) and slim 175MB image.
[What rivals shipped recently] AnythingLLM v1.16.2 replaces Docker Model Runner with LLMman; Jan v0.8.4 (Jul) has no Aug-Sep release; Cline SDK cut mistake-limit 6.34% to 0.62%.
[Self-verification and reasoning effort] gpt-oss low/medium/high and Qwen3 think/no-think give prompt-level effort control that works locally today via llama.cpp template kwargs
[Self-verification and reasoning effort] llama.cpp now enforces real thinking-token budgets (--reasoning-budget + transition message) but per-model quirks require soak-testing

[Self-verification and reasoning effort] Intrinsic self-correction without external feedback degrades reasoning; spend verification budget on compiler/test grounding, concise prompts, and early-stopped parallel sampling instead
[Local memory and document search] Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B plus Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B both run locally via llama-server and form the default offline recall plus rerank pair
[Local memory and document search] Consensus local pipeline is tantivy BM25 plus cosine vectors fused by RRF k=60 with a tau=0.50 rejection gate and fact-level atomic chunking
[Local memory and document search] sqlite-vec (exact) and LanceDB (embedded ANN plus versioning) cover the no-server store ladder; docling.rs gives a Rust-native Windows ingestion path
[New security issues in local AI tools] llama.cpp RPC UAF gives unauthenticated RCE before b8585 (CVSS 9.2); Cerebro must pin new builds and never expose RPC.
[New security issues in local AI tools] Ollama tensor-blob redirect SSRF (CVE-2026-85180, 0.30.0-0.33.2) has no merged fix; treat model pulls as SSRF-capable.
[New security issues in local AI tools] MCP tool/metadata poisoning is the trending live technique (Deadbugz Aug 2026, cache-scope chaining); requires continuous schema checks.
[New security issues in local AI tools] Sept 2026 agent cluster: GitSpawn (7 agents), Plugin4Shell (Copilot unpatched), Sentry PhantomFix (CVE-2026-90999, unpatched).
[New security issues in local AI tools] Malicious GGUF files are proven RCE (parser overflows, chat-template SSTI); pin llama.cpp >= b8146 and sandbox model loading.
